units.source_text: 罗连听到伞女的忏悔，微微额首，这时他全身肌肤头发已经焦毁，四肢无法动弹，默然不语，只能听着。

en.t: When Loren heard the umbrella woman's confession, he gave a slight nod; by then the skin and hair all over his body had been burned and charred, his limbs could no longer move, and he could only listen in silence.

units.source_text: 伞翁如五脏欲裂，于是和西美昂一起跑到罗连的旁边希望能够救助他。

en.t: The umbrella old man felt as if his very organs would split apart, so he ran with Simeon to Loren's side, hoping they might save him.

units.source_text: 罗连气喘吁吁，弥留之际，如平日一样眼神熠熠生辉，仰望天空。

en.t: Loren was gasping for breath; at the edge of death, his eyes shone as brightly as they always had, and he looked up at the sky.
